definitions.explanation: A benefit or kindness received from someone that creates a sense of indebtedness.
The feeling of obligation to repay kindness received.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{恩|おん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忘|わす}れません→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: I will never forget my teacher's kindness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{恩|おん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{裏切|うらぎ}る→裏切る：02011_uragiru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I cannot betray someone to whom I owe my life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧{恩|おん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧、⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{返|かえ}したい→返す：09648_kaesu⟧。
examples.english: I want to repay the kindness I received as a child, now that I am an adult.

notes:
{恩|おん} refers to a favor or kindness received that creates a sense of obligation. It is an important concept in Japanese culture.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {恩|おん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to receive a favor)
- {恩|おん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to feel indebted)
- {恩|おん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{報|むく}いる→報いる：12088_mukuiru⟧ (to repay a favor)
- {恩|おん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧ (to never forget someone's kindness)
- {恩|おん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{返|かえ}す→返す：09648_kaesu⟧ (to repay a favor)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {恩|おん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{仇|あだ}→仇：11476_kataki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{返|かえ}す→返す：09648_kaesu⟧ (repay kindness with ingratitude)
- {恩|おん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧ (to feel obligated for a favor)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{恩人|おんじん}→恩人：02566_onjin⟧ (benefactor)
- ⟦{恩返|おんがえ}し→恩返し：11063_ongaeshi⟧ (returning a favor)
- ⟦{恩恵|おんけい}→恩恵：04115_onkei⟧ (grace, blessing)

CULTURAL NOTE: The concept of {恩|おん} is central to Japanese social relationships, emphasizing the importance of reciprocity and gratitude.
